note: Placeholder wording for development, a draft for the doctor partner to review: not reviewed medical content. Status draft until a clinic's doctor has checked every label and instruction. Seeded by salusctl document-templates seed.

fields.label: Razlog pregleda
fields.instruction: Zašto je pacijent došao, njegovim riječima, kratko.

fields.label: Anamneza
fields.instruction: Tegobe, njihovo trajanje i tok, kako ih pacijent opisuje.

fields.label: Nalaz
fields.instruction: Šta je ljekar utvrdio tokom pregleda, samo ono što je rečeno u razgovoru.

fields.label: Dijagnoza (MKB-10)
fields.instruction: Šifra MKB-10 samo ako ju je ljekar izgovorio ili jasno naveo dijagnozu.

fields.label: Preporučene pretrage
fields.instruction: Svaka pretraga koju je ljekar preporučio, jedna po redu.

fields.label: Terapija i preporuke
fields.instruction: Lijekovi, doze i savjeti koje je ljekar dao.

reason.label: Reason for the visit
reason.instruction: Why the patient came, in their words, briefly.

history.label: History
history.instruction: Complaints, how long and how they developed, as the patient describes them.

findings.label: Findings
findings.instruction: What the practitioner established during the consultation, only what was said.

diagnosis.label: Diagnosis (ICD-10)
diagnosis.instruction: The ICD-10 code only if the practitioner said it or clearly named the diagnosis.

tests.label: Recommended tests
tests.instruction: Each test the practitioner recommended, one per line.

therapy.label: Treatment and advice
therapy.instruction: Medicines, doses and advice the practitioner gave.

control.label: Follow-up visit
control.instruction: The date of the follow-up if one was agreed.
